scope: Bounded sequential R2 prefixes, exploratory sample consistency; not recovered author donor identity, full raw assay reconstruction, genotype-based clinical identification, or validated snRNA-seq germline genotyping
policy: Unique author donor IDs and tissue relationships cannot be reconstructed from this audit. Tumor LOH, allele-specific expression, PCR duplication and nonrandom prefixes limit genotype interpretation; no donor-independent nuclear P value is added.
